published_papers.title: Reliable Mining of Heterogeneous AI Coding-Agent Data: Context-Aware Prediction and Resource-Aware Ranking
published_papers.research_limitations: The 71,677 PR study is observational, mixes six attributed agents and retrospective metadata, and excludes Codex from its primary overlap-sensitive ranking analysis. Creation-time temporal AUC is 0.641; observed human-attribution mode is not assigned human review or a causal intervention.
